那片麦子烧了三天，俺蹲沟里闻了三天糊味。: That wheat burned three days. I hid in a ditch and smelled it the whole time.
死人老实，不抢食也不骗人。俺宁可守着死人。: The dead are honest. They don't steal or lie. I'd rather keep them company.
白哥，你半夜磨刀那沙沙声，听得俺后背发凉。: Boss Bai, that rasp when you whet your blade at night sends chills down my back.
胡饼刚从灶灰里扒出来，揣怀里，出刀不心慌。: Flatbread fresh from the ashes. Tuck it in. Easier to swing on a full belly.
白哥瞅着比俺还小，满头头发咋全白了？: Boss Bai, you look younger than me. How'd your hair go all white?
俺瓦罐里攒了些五铢钱，等你忙完，咱打壶好酒。: I've saved some coins in a jar. When you're done, we'll get a good jug of wine.
路滑，早些回来，俺在窑门口点着柴堆等你。: Roads are icy. Come back early. I'll keep a fire lit at the kiln door.
束胸布勒那么死，换气不顺。这破窑里没人看你。: You bind your chest too tight to breathe. Nobody's looking in this kiln.
老身这只瞎眼，是在宫墙里哭坏的。你这双呢？: I cried this eye blind inside the palace walls. What about yours?
杜五那愣头青，到现在还当你是条铁打的好汉。: That fool Du Wu still thinks you're a man made of iron.
嘴上不肯喝外人的汤，倒记得杜五拿鞋换的诊金。: Won't drink a stranger's broth, but you remember Du Wu paid me in shoes.
伸手烤烤炭火。肉长的手冻僵了，刀可不认人。: Warm your hands. Frozen flesh can't hold a blade.
外头尽是死人烂肉，看不见，倒省得脏了眼。: Out there it's all corpses and rot. Not seeing it spares your eyes.
苦药在瓦罐里咕嘟着。喝一口，能多挺半宿。: Bitter medicine's bubbling in the jar. One sip buys you half a night.
去吧。灶上给你留着温水，回来把血泥洗掉。: Go. There's warm water on the stove. Wash off the blood when you're back.
那人我一勺勺喂了三天姜汤。那夜，是他抽的门闩。: I fed that man ginger broth for three days. That night, he drew the bolt.
文皎留在腊月廿三了。活下来的是刘白。: Wen Jiao stayed in that night. Liu Bai is who lived.
那夜抱着阿爹坐到天亮，雪落了一头，没再化过。: I held my father until dawn. Snow settled in my hair and never melted.
石雷，阎虎，封寒，周默，崔玄。……一个不留。: Shi Lei. Yan Hu. Feng Han. Zhou Mo. Cui Xuan. ...None left.
第一道刻痕，摸上去还是冰的。: The first line. Still cold to the touch.
他临死那句话，到底什么意思。: What did he mean, at the end?
第二道刻痕。石粉粘在指腹上。: The second line. Stone dust on my fingertips.
他说阿娘是从崔府逃出来的……我不信。: He said Mother fled the Cui house... I don't believe it.
三把刀回来了。阿爹的手指也带回来了。: Three blades back. Father's thumb too.
替他收账……收完他们，就轮到他。: Collecting his debts... When they're done, it's his turn.
那碗姜汤，该连本带利还清了。: Time to repay that broth, with interest.
上面四个，都划平了。: The four above are all struck out.
最底下，只剩这两个字。: At the bottom, only his name is left.
血脉算什么。烧死阿娘的火，是他点的。: Blood means nothing. He lit the fire that killed Mother.
崔府后沟这死人，冻得梆硬，衣裳都扒不下来。: This corpse in the Cui ditch is frozen stiff. Can't even strip the clothes off.
图行头？他把扒死人换的铜钱全塞给我，求我来接骨。: After your clothes? He gave me every coin he got off the dead to set your bones.
瞪俺干啥？俺本来是去沟里扒死人东西换钱的。: Why the glare? I only went to that ditch to pick the dead for coin.
嘴上不肯喝外人的汤，倒记得杜五替你付的药钱。: Won't drink a stranger's broth, but you remember Du Wu paid for your medicine.
冻死鬼的衣裳，扒都扒不下来。: Frozen stiff. Can't even strip the clothes off.
